def search_safe(request):

// 文件上传管理器：按条件列出已上传文件记录
function listUploadedFiles(PDO $pdo, array $params): array
{
    $sortKey = $params['sort'] ?? 'date';
    // 白名单精确允许集：枚举全部合法排序键并映射为固定 SQL 片段
    $sortWhitelist = [
        'name' => 'file_name ASC',
        'date' => 'uploaded_at DESC',
        'size' => 'file_size DESC',
    ];
    // 不在枚举内的键一律回退默认项，进入 SQL 的只能是映射表常量
    $orderClause = $sortWhitelist[$sortKey] ?? $sortWhitelist['date'];

    $typeKey = $params['type'] ?? 'all';
    $typeWhitelist = [
        'all'   => null,
        'image' => 'image',
        'doc'   => 'document',
        'video' => 'video',
    ];
    $typeFilter = $typeWhitelist[$typeKey] ?? null;

    $sql = 'SELECT id, file_name, file_size, uploaded_at FROM uploads';
    $bindings = [];
    if ($typeFilter !== null) {
        $sql .= ' WHERE file_type = :ftype';
        $bindings[':ftype'] = $typeFilter;
    }
    $sql .= ' ORDER BY ' . $orderClause;

    $stmt = $pdo->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute($bindings);
    return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
}
